slides.title: Landscapers switching to snow removal: can you get 2/2?
slides.body: Answers on the next slides. No peeking.

slides.label: Question 1
slides.title: Adding snow removal this winter. Does your landscaping insurance cover it?
slides.body: Not always. Ask your agent before the first storm, not after.

slides.label: Question 2
slides.title: A crew member's driver's license expired last month. Can they drive the plow truck?
slides.body: Nope. Check crew licenses too, not just yours.

slides.title: Never miss a renewal again
slides.body: CertTrack tracks your licenses, permits and policies and alerts you before they expire.
